title: te hononga i karanga ai i te whakangaromanga
intro: Whakaarohia kei raro i te tuanui kotahi i reira te whakakitenga, engari e whiriwhiri ana i tētahi atu pono. I noho tata tonu tēnei tangata ki te pono me te poropititanga, engari i tahuri ki te hunga i whakakahore. Ko tā rātou kōrero he whakatūpato nui e kore e taea e te tata ki te tika anake te whakaora i te wairua e tinihanga ana i te whakawhirinakitanga.
clues: I noho ahau i roto i te whare o tetahi poropiti i whiriwhiria e Allah.
I mōhio ahau ki te pono i kauwhautia e taku tāne, heoi kāore ahau i tino whakapono ki taua mea.
I tinihanga ahau i tōna whakawhirinaki mā te tautoko i te hunga whakahē i a ia, me te āwhina i a rātou ki te whawhai ki a ia.
Kua whakahuatia ahau i te taha o te wahine a tētahi atu poropiti i tinihanga hoki, hei tauira mā te hunga whakaponokore.
Kei roto i te Surah At-Tahrim taku kōrero hei whakatūpato kāore he tiaki a te whanaungatanga ki ngā poropiti.
I mate tahi ahau me te hunga hara i te wā i whakangaromia ai e te Atua te iwi o Rutu, i mahue iho me te hunga i toe.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te Wahine a te Poropiti a Ruta
Asiya, te wahine a Parao
Te wahine a Imran
Ko Hara, te wahine a te Poropiti a Ihāperaima
Te Wahine a Al-Aziz
identity.answer: Te Wahine a te Poropiti a Ruta

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I tinihanga i te poropiti mā te āwhina i te hunga whakaponokore ki te whawhai ki a ia
Makahia he pēpi ki roto i te awa i roto i te kete hei whakaora i a ia
I tono kia hangaia he kuao kau koura i te wā e ngaro ana te poropiti
I whakapae i tētahi minita tika mō te hē, ā, i hereherea ia
I ārahi i tētahi ope taua arewhana ki te whakangaro i te Kaaba
trial.answer: I tinihanga i te poropiti mā te āwhina i te hunga whakaponokore ki te whawhai ki a ia

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Ngā tāone i hurihia o te iwi o Ruta
Te Āka i hangaia i raro i te whakahau a te Atua
Nā te ahi i whakamatao a Ibrahim
Te ana piringa mō ngā taiohi e moe ana
Te awa i kitea ai te kete a te pēpi
location.answer: Ngā tāone i hurihia o te iwi o Ruta

outcome.label: Hua
options: I mate tahi me te hunga whakaponokore ahakoa i marena ki te poropiti
I whakaorangia ngātahitia me te hunga whakapono, ā, i tomo ki Pararaiha i roto i te rangimārie
I hurihia hei pou hei tohu mō ngā whakatupuranga o muri mai
I horomia e te whenua me ngā taonga nui whakaharahara
I whakawhiwhia ki tētahi tamaiti merekara i te koroheketanga
outcome.answer: I mate tahi me te hunga whakaponokore ahakoa i marena ki te poropiti

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
